name: data.gov.uk CKAN API
tagline: Search and access UK government open datasets via the official CKAN catalog API.
description: data.gov.uk is the UK government's open data portal, powered by CKAN. Its Action API lets developers search the catalog, retrieve package/dataset metadata, list organizations and tags, and discover resource download URLs for thousands of public datasets from central and local government. The portal is free to use; catalog queries typically need no API key, while write operations require authentication. Responses are JSON from the standard CKAN /api/3/action/ endpoints hosted at ckan.publishing.service.gov.uk.

auth.details: Public catalog reads (package_search, package_show, etc.) require no authentication. Write/admin actions need a CKAN API key via Authorization header; keys are issued to registered data.gov.uk users with appropriate permissions.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public access for catalog search and metadata; no published paid plans for API access

use_cases: search UK government open datasets by keyword
get metadata and resource download URLs for a known dataset
list datasets published by a government organization
discover available tags and groups in the UK open data catalog
find transport, health, or environment datasets for secondary analysis
